doc: Saturation at both ends and special floats, float32: +-64 (256 -> 255, 0), 63.5 (255 exactly), 63.75 (255.5 -> 256 -> clip 255), -64.25, +-100, +-1e6, +-3e38 (v / 0.5 overflows float32 to infinity, the clip gives 255 and 0), +-inf, +0.0 and -0.0 (both 128). NaN is excluded: astype(uint8) of NaN is undefined. Exact bytes.
